meta.title: Install Luma CMS
meta.description: Browser setup wizard — no terminal required. Complete these steps once, then sign in at /admin/login.
language.label: Language
welcome.title: Welcome to Luma CMS
welcome.intro: This wizard configures your database, site settings, and owner account. You only run it once after uploading the release archive to your hosting account.
welcome.webRootHelp: point your domain at the folder containing index.php and apps/
welcome.defaultsHelp: Safe defaults are used for cache, session, and queue (file/file/database). Redis is not required on shared hosting.
requirements.accessDenied: Could not read server requirements (access denied). Check nginx /api/ routing.
database.help: Test the connection before continuing. Credentials are saved to .env on your server — never displayed in the browser after save.
database.driver.label: Database driver
database.name: Database name
site.title: Site title
site.help: Used as the site name in settings and as a fallback label for your owner profile.
owner.name: Owner name
owner.passwordHelp: Minimum 12 characters. The first account receives the owner role with full system access.
owner.passwordHelpWeak: Minimum 8 characters when weak passwords are allowed.
owner.allowWeakPasswordHelp: Use only for development or staging. On production, use at least 12 characters.
owner.starterSite: Install starter business site (home page, menus, contact form)
install.help: Luma CMS will write your configuration, run migrations, create the owner account, and optionally install starter content. Session, cache, and queue use file/file/database drivers — no Redis required.
install.migrations: Run database migrations and seed roles
log.title: Setup log
log.empty: Log entries appear as setup steps run.
errors.password.minLength: Use at least {min} characters for the owner password.
errors.password.strongRequired: Choose a stronger password — avoid common defaults like "password" or "admin".
errors.requirements.accessDenied: Could not read server requirements (access denied). Check nginx /api/ routing.
errors.database.envNotWritable: Unable to create apps/api/.env. Make the apps/api folder writable by the web server.
errors.database.envMergeFailed: Unable to write database settings to .env.
errors.finish.rateLimited: Too many setup attempts. Please wait and try again.
requirements.php_version.label: PHP version
requirements.php_version.failed: PHP {minimum} or newer is required (Laravel 13). Current: {current}. Select PHP 8.3+ in your hosting panel. PHP 7.x and 8.0–8.2 are not supported.
requirements.php_version.warning_unsuppo: PHP {current} works but branch {branch} is not in the tested legacy set ({supported}). Recommended: {recommended}+.
requirements.php_version.warning_below_r: PHP {current} is supported. Recommended upgrade to {recommended}+ when your host allows it.
requirements.php_extensions.label: PHP extensions
requirements.php_extensions.passed: All required PHP extensions are loaded.
requirements.paths_writable.label: Writable directories
requirements.paths_writable.passed: Storage, bootstrap cache, and database directory are writable.
requirements.vendor_autoload.label: Application vendor bundle
requirements.vendor_autoload.failed: vendor/autoload.php is missing. Use a release archive with bundled vendor or run composer install locally.
